d:
Build your chest, improve your push-up endurance, and get a solid upper-body workout in just 15 minutes — no equipment needed.
A lot more workouts like this on the Gritty Soldier app. Full, structured plan, and I’ll guide you for every workout and every exercise: (weekly training schedule is coming soon! )
This military-style calisthenics chest workout is designed to be followed along with me from start to finish. We’ll hit multiple push-up variations to challenge your chest, triceps, shoulders, and muscular endurance.
WORKOUT: 15 Minutes
FORMAT: 30 Sec Work / 30 Sec Rest
EQUIPMENT: None
